notes: Access: direct fetch worked throughout (HTTP 200 on homepage, all collection pages and products.json endpoints); one later robots.txt request hit a transient Cloudflare 'verifying your connection' challenge (HTTP 429) after ~15 requests, but this did not block any of the substantive data-gathering, which all completed successfully beforehand -- no Claude-specific disallow was ever observed. Wonderchef is a Shopify store (1059 total products site-wide per /collections/all/products.json). Method: fetched the full site-wide product catalogue (1059 products, paginated products.json, limit=250) and grouped by the store's own 'product_type' field to avoid double-counting (Wonderchef cross-tags the same SKU into many overlapping SEO collections -- e.g. raw collection landing-page labels like 'Drinkware'=344, 'Home Decor'=63, 'Serveware'=84 in the sitemap dump are heavily inflated/stale; every qty below is instead an exhaustive products.json enumeration, either of the exact product_type bucket or of a verified 1:1-matching collection). SCOPE: Wonderchef is fundamentally a cookware/kitchen-appliance manufacturer (Cookware, Cooktop, Cookers, Air Fryer, Mixer Grinder, Chimneys, Coffee Machines, OTGs, Kettles, Choppers, Bakeware, Kitchen Accessories/tools, Cutlery, Spare Parts, Storage & Containers, Kitchen & Table Linen -- all out of scope per the cookware/appliance/cutlery/hardware/textile exclusions) totalling 967 of 1059 products. It does carry one narrow in-scope slice: Dinnerware (21: Sicilia fine bone china, Teramo stoneware, Venice melamine/steel plates-bowls-katoris-dinner sets), Drinkware/glassware (41 of 42: Modena and Bormioli Rocco glass tumblers/wine/whiskey/champagne/beer glasses plus Sicilia/Teramo ceramic mugs and cups), functional Serveware (5: casseroles, a multipurpose container/tray, a glass casserole+bowl set, a condiment set) and a small legacy line of decorative wooden Casablanca trays and coasters (16, tagged EOL but still live). EXCLUSIONS applied: 150 Spare Parts; all cookware/appliance/cutlery/kitchen-tool/bakeware/storage/linen product_types (see above); 1 stainless-steel straw set (drinking accessory, not glassware/dinnerware); the 'Ambrosia Water Jug and Glass 5 Pc. Set' (BPA-free plastic, not glass, filed by the site itself under 'Kitchen Accessories' not Drinkware/Dinnerware); 2 Valentina placemats (textile); 2 Ambrosia stainless-steel pet bowls (pet supplies, not human tableware/decor); the 'Harmony Premium Stainless-Steel Dinner & Pooja Gift Set' (mixed dinnerware+pooja/religious items+gift bundle, filed by the site as 'Kitchen Accessories' not Dinnerware); the site's own 'Home Decor' collection (products.json confirms it is EMPTY -- 0 products, despite the sitemap dump claiming 63 -- a stale/dead legacy collection, consistent with the project's known Shopify products_count-inflation pattern); the 3181-count 'Corporate Gifting' and 738-count 'Gifting' collections (mixed roll-ups / gift-guide pages, never extracted per rule). STATUS: marked 'partial' rather than 'ok' because Wonderchef's in-scope footprint (83 of 1059 products, under 8%) is a genuine but marginal side-line to its core cookware/appliance business -- exactly the narrow slice the task brief anticipated -- and several of the leaf buckets (Serveware, Decorative Trays) required manual title-level curation rather than a single clean site-native count, so confidence, while good, is not at the 'ok' bar. No qty is null; every leaf is a verified, evidenced exact count -- 'partial' reflects scope-breadth/curation-confidence, not count uncertainty. DUPLICATE-COMPANY CHECK: Wonderchef (wonderchef.com) is a well-known, single, distinctive Indian houseware/small-appliance brand (est. 2013, Sanjeev Kapoor-associated); no evidence found of it being a duplicate or sub-brand of another company already processed in this project.

rows.evidence: Exact count via site-wide products.json enumeration (all 1059 products in /collections/all/products.json, paginated limit=250) grouped by the store's own 'product_type' facet: product_type=='Dinnerware' = 21 (Sicilia Fine Bone China plates/bowls/katoris, Teramo stoneware plates/bowls/platter, Venice melamine and stainless-steel plate/bowl/dinner sets). The live /collections/dinnerware storefront page shows 36 because it cross-tags in Drinkware/Serveware items too (same double-count pattern seen on other Shopify houseware sites in this project); qty here is the deduplicated product_type bucket, not the raw collection page.

Exact count via /collections/glasses-tumblers-drinkware/products.json (paginated, deduped by product id): 28 products found. All are actual glass drinkware (Modena and Bormioli Rocco branded whiskey/wine/champagne/juice/water glasses, highball glasses, beer mugs, tumblers). This is a clean sub-partition of product_type=='Drinkware' (42 total): 28 glasses/tumblers + 13 mugs/cups + 1 excluded straw set = 42, verified.

Exact count via /collections/mugs-cups-drinkware/products.json (paginated, deduped by product id): 13 products found -- Sicilia fine bone china mugs, Teramo stoneware kullad/tea-cup/soup-mug, and Modena/Rosa glass beer mugs and dessert cups. Confirmed as the remainder of product_type=='Drinkware' not already counted in Glasses & Tumblers (28+13=41 of 42; the 42nd is an excluded stainless-steel straw set, see notes).

Manually enumerated from product_type=='Serveware' (22) and 'Home & Living' (3) buckets in the site-wide products.json dump, keeping only genuine table-serving vessels and excluding the 16 decorative Casablanca trays/coasters (counted separately under Home Decor below) and 2 Valentina placemats (textile, excluded): Venice Casserole - Red (Set of 2); Venice Casserole - Royal Red (Set of 6); Venice Multipurpose Container & Tray - Grey Tiles (Set of 9); Victoria Borosilicate Glass Casserole + Mixing Bowl Set of 2 Pcs; Modena Stainless-steel 7 Pc. Condiment Set. = 5 products. The live /collections/serveware page shows 22 (includes the Casablanca decor items and a stainless-steel Cookware Set item that is excluded per cookware exclusion).

Exact count via /collections/casablanca/products.json (paginated, deduped by product id): 16 products found -- all wooden decorative trays, bed trays and coasters (abstract, geometric, marble-mosaic, damask-motif, ornamental-tile patterns). product_type=='Serveware' on these SKUs but they are decorative wood accent pieces, not dining serveware, so filed under Home Decor per Rule 0 (product type/nature over collection label). Note: all 16 carry 'EOL2023'/'EOL2026' tags (end-of-life markers) but remain live, in-stock listings as of this check, so counted as active.
